newsitem.title: UK: RTZ shares drift lower as FTSE 100 eases.
newsitem.headline: RTZ shares drift lower as FTSE 100 eases.

text.p: Shares in UK mining group RTZ Corp Plc fell on Wednesday, due in part to downward pressure on the UK's leading index but helped by weak gold prices and the declaration of December copper options.
At 1240 GMT the stock was down 13p at 974-1/2p after closing 2p firmer at 987-1/2 on Tuesday.
Gold prices hit a three-year low on Tuesday, but were seen bouncing back slightly on Wednesday.
"Clearly the gold prices had a slight impact," said an industry analyst. "But the fall (in RTZ shares) has more to do with the rest of the FTSE."
Analysts commented that some investors may be cashing in on recent gains in the share price.
"RTZ has been a strong market recently," one analyst said. "It's understandable if people want to take profits in a weak market."
Traders said there had been no major impact from the December copper option declarations at 1130 GMT.
At 1240 GMT, the FTSE 100 index was down 22.1 points at 4039.4.
